scope: Rolling Ball Interception offline vanilla LeWM baseline

data.action_semantics: absolute seven joint targets and binary gripper intent
data.normalization: train-only unique action rows mean/unbiased std (ddof=1), floor 1e-6; official RGB transform
data.success_label: not explicit in release; no assumed per-episode success gate

training.checkpoint_selection: epoch100_last; best validation prediction MSE checkpoint is diagnostic only
training.selection_reason: encoder scale changes during joint training; smallest latent MSE across epochs does not establish better task capability

task_adaptations: frameskip 1 replaces official PushT frameskip 5 to match native 40 ms Rolling control
8-D absolute joint action replaces PushT action dimension
episode-disjoint 180/20 split replaces sample-level random split

closed_loop.hardware_constraint: only A100 available; native Isaac RGB path requires supported GPU with RT cores
closed_loop.goal_cost_and_cem_config: offline adapter frozen in PLANNER_FREEZE.json; native RGB task smoke remains pending; no test future state
